description: Drive one app toward a goal in one call, with the judge worker choosing each step by element (invoke, set_value, toggle or select by ref; no mouse, keyboard, scrolling or menus). Needs a native session and app_name or app_pid. State the goal as the end state and pass field text as `inputs` keyed by field label. Returns a status, the steps, and the app's tree with live refs for computer::act; `done` is the judge's reading, so confirm with computer::find. Approving a run approves every action it takes: not for destructive actions. Without a judge worker it returns judge_unavailable; drive with computer::find + computer::act.

app_name.description: Exact, case-sensitive app name as the OS reports it (as in computer::find). One of app_name or app_pid is required.

app_pid.description: Process id of the app to drive. One of app_name or app_pid is required.

goal.description: The end state to reach, as the app would show it ("the contact Ana is saved and listed"), not the clicks to make. Name every value the outcome needs.

inputs.description: Text for fields the goal needs filled, keyed by the field's label (case, accents and punctuation ignored: `email` for "E-mail"); `password` also reaches a field the OS marks as a password, and a word its description names (a slicer's `layer_height`) reaches the one text field whose description names it. Only the keys are shown to the judge, but a field that is not secret shows its typed value in later trees.

max_steps.description: Most actions to execute (default 10, at most 60).

timeout_ms.description: Whole-run budget in ms (default 60000, at most 240000).

input_keys.description: The `inputs` keys the run was given, none of which matched this field.

ref.description: A live ref in `tree` for computer::act set_value.

oneOf.description: The judge chose DONE and its completion check rated the goal complete in the app. It is the judge's reading, not proof: confirm with computer::find.
The judge found no operation that makes progress, or was not confident enough to act (see `reason`).
Actions changed nothing, or the judge repeated one that changed nothing.
A field must be typed and no `inputs` entry matches it: set_value it by `needs_text.ref` (or rerun with `inputs`).

The run lost certainty about the app: input from outside it, the session stopped, an action whose effect is unknown, or a failed read (see `reason`). Observe again before acting; the refs in `tree` may be stale.
No usable judge (not deployed, no provider, failing, or the tree too large for it). Drive with computer::find + computer::act; `tree` is current.

changed.description: The app's tree changed after the action.

error.description: Why the element refused the action, or why its effect is unknown.

probability.description: The judge's probability for the executed choice.

target.description: The element acted on, as the tree printed it.

tree.description: Untrusted app text: the app's tree as the run last read it, in computer::observe's format, with refs live for computer::act (unless the status is `interrupted`).
